DebugView.LivePluginDisabledMessage: Debug View requires the Live plugin to be activated.
DebugView.PageDescription: Watch tracking requests arrive in real time. Select a site to see its incoming hits from the last 30 minutes. Note that excluded visits are currently not shown here, and Heatmap & Session Recording requests may not be shown either. Bot requests are shown and marked as such.
DebugView.PollingErrorMessage: The last request for new hits failed. Retrying automatically…
DebugView.ProcessedAggregatedHint: These details are updated over time by multiple tracking requests (for example media progress or form interaction updates). This request is one of them.
DebugView.ProcessedCannotBeShown: Cannot be shown for this type of request.
DebugView.ProcessedNotAvailableBot: This request was identified as a bot request and was not processed into a visit, so no processed hit or visit details exist.
DebugView.VisitNotAvailable: Visit details are not available. The visit may have been purged, or its data has not been written yet.
DebugView.VisitsLogDisabledMessage: Debug View streams data from the Visits Log, which is currently disabled for this site or system-wide. To use Debug View, the Visits Log needs to be enabled in the Live plugin settings or the Measurable settings. Depending on your permissions, you may need to ask an administrator to make this change.
DebugView.VisitsLogDisabledTitle: The Visits Log is not available
DebugView.WaitingForRequestsHint: Only tracking requests sent with the debug=1 URL parameter show up here. Enable it on your website via _paq.push(['enableDebugMode']), or add debug=1 to a matomo.php request, and it will appear within a few seconds.
